description: This Java class named LogView extends TextView and implements LogNode to display log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and Throwable details and appends them to the view, also forwarding to the next LogNode in the chain.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A TextView subclass that displays formatted log messages received via the LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data with priority, tag, message, and exception details and appends it to the LogView, then forwards the log to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
